name: @estebanforge/pi-zendesk-me
description: Zendesk Support read tools for Pi. Adds 7 LLM-callable tools (zendesk_*) that query the Zendesk Support API v2 over HTTPS: fetch a ticket (by id or agent URL), read the comment thread, search tickets, look up users and organizations, download attachments
